name: MacroHFT retry HF access discovery and isolated pinned client setup
command:
import json,os,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
out=Path(os.environ['CQ_OUTPUT_DIR']);out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
root=Path('/date/zyy/macrohft-reproduction')
candidates=[root/'.hf/token',root/'.cache/huggingface/token',Path.home()/'.cache/huggingface/token']
a={'project_credential_files':[{'path':str(p),'exists':p.is_file(),'contents_read':False,'project_owned_location':str(p).startswith(str(root))} for p in candidates],'hf_token_environment_present':bool(os.environ.get('HF_TOKEN')),'shared_credentials_used':False}
(out/'auth-check.json').write_text(json.dumps(a,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(a),flush=True)
t=time.monotonic();r={'probe_complete':True,'private_assets_uploaded':False}
try:r['client_smoke_exit_code']=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'scripts/cq_asset_smoke.py'],timeout=720).returncode
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:r['client_smoke_exit_code']='timeout'
r['client_smoke_passed']=r['client_smoke_exit_code']==0;r['elapsed_seconds']=time.monotonic()-t
(out/'retry.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n');(out/'progress.log').write_text('5/5 retry probe finished; inspect retry.json for success\n');print(json.dumps(r),flush=True)

resource_basis.scope: User-requested retry of missing credential metadata and previously failed isolated official client installation; public 548-byte pinned fixture only if install succeeds
resource_basis.bounds: 1 CPU, 2 GB RAM/disk, no GPUs or charges; .5h limit; no shared environment changes or credential contents in output
resource_basis.prior_success: Do not resubmit the already-passed old-client smoke; this qualifies the previously blocked fresh pinned client environment.
